description.p: triM. is a modern, fast, and native non-linear video editor designed for Linux. Built natively with Rust, egui, and FFmpeg, it offers a focused workflow for video cutting, multi-track editing, audio mixing, and exporting.

ul.li: Multi-track timeline with ripple edits, snapping, and frame-accurate navigation
Real-time preview monitor with live stereo audio VU metering
Interactive fade handles, picture-in-picture transformations, and color adjustments
Title and text generation with typography controls

screenshot.caption: 9:16 Vertical Shorts/Reels Canvas with Safe Zones
Multi-channel Audio Mixer and VU Meters
Hardware-Accelerated Export Studio and Loudness Normalization

description.p: triM. v1.1.2 - Timeline Track Overflow and Vertical Scrolling Fix:

ul.li: Smooth Vertical Scrolling: Added synchronized bidirectional vertical scrolling for track headers and timeline canvas when adding multiple video/audio tracks.
Timeline Panel Sizing: Fixed panel splitter resizing constraints, preventing unwanted vertical panel expansion when adding tracks.
Pinned Timeline Ruler: The timeline ruler and playhead remain securely pinned at the top while scrolling vertically through tracks.

description.p: triM. v1.1.1 - Multi-track Audio-Video Auto-Pairing and Enhanced Camera Media Support:

ul.li: Intelligent Video-to-Audio Track Pairing: Videos placed on V1 pair their audio to A1, V2 pairs to A2, V3 to A3, with automatic track creation.
Synchronized Target Track Patching: Selecting a target video track automatically syncs the corresponding audio target track.
Canon Camera QuickTime MOV Support: Resilient metadata parsing for QuickTime container tags, frame rate fallback, and uncompressed Linear PCM audio.
Case-insensitive File Dialog Filters: Full support for uppercase camera file extensions (.MOV, .MP4, .JPG, .PNG).

description.p: triM. v1.1.0 introduces industry-standard FCPXML (v1.8/v1.9) and CMX 3600 EDL sequence import and export, cinematic motion title templates (Typewriter, Lower Thirds, Cinematic Zoom, News Ticker, Box Reveal), timeline thumbnail filmstrips, interactive audio volume rubberband dB gain curves, media pool folders (bins) with breadcrumb navigation and smart media type filters, ripple delete gaps, automatic audio/video clip linking, clip color labels, default 4-track timeline structure (V2, V1, A1, A2), and an overhauled Export Video Studio dialog.

triM. v1.0.1 brings full Windows x86_64 MSVC compatibility, OpenGL 3.3 / GLES 3.0 off-screen FBO GPU preview compositing, a 5 ms lookahead brickwall master bus limiter, non-blocking asynchronous native file dialogs, J-K-L shuttle transport, magnetic timeline snapping with visual guides, and a redesigned Project Hub welcome screen.

triM. v1.0.0 is the first major production milestone! Featuring a complete native non-linear video editing workflow: interactive on-screen Type tool (T) with real-time viewport text placement and automatic timeline clip generation, multi-NLE keyboard shortcut profiles (triM., Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve), CMX 3600 EDL and Final Cut Pro XML sequence interoperability, 3-point interactive Color Wheels (Lift, Gamma, Gain), real-time Chroma Key green screen compositor, Ken Burns Pan & Zoom motion presets, Subtitle Suite (.SRT/.VTT), Smart Scene Detection, timeline voiceover recording, 4K Smart Proxy workflow, and GPU-accelerated export.

triM. v0.6.0 adds Subtitle Suite (.SRT/.VTT) import and export, Smart Scene Detection auto-cut using FFmpeg scene score, 3D LUT support (.cube) with cinematic color grading presets (Teal & Orange, Vintage Film, Monochrome Noir, Cyberpunk Neon), Live Timeline Voiceover recording directly on audio tracks, Smart Proxy workflow for smooth 4K/UHD playback, and dynamic Keyboard Shortcut Profiles (triM. Default, Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve).

triM. v0.5.0 adds GPU hardware-accelerated exports (NVIDIA NVENC, Intel QSV, AMD AMF, Linux VAAPI), 9:16 vertical Shorts/Reels canvas mode with interactive Safe Zones guides, EBU R128 loudness normalization, Voice Clarity and Podcast EQ presets with Noise Gate, real-time Live Titler and subtitle generator, and standalone portable project archiving.

triM. v0.4.0 represents a complete transition to 100% native Rust, a redesigned 4-quadrant NLE interface, an 8-tool vector editing toolbar, track audio mixer, Export Studio presets, cross-platform standard paths, and native Windows support with silent process execution and one-line installers.
triM. v0.3.0 introduces timeline markers with magnetic snapping, keyframe animation for transform and opacity properties, and variable clip playback speed and reverse.
triM. v0.2.0 introduces multi-clip selection and batch manipulation, track mixer with mute/solo controls, audio detach workflow, and Q/W ripple trim shortcuts.
